title: Remove unused task entity from default CRM
description: Tasks are not part of the Inmovel workflow. Remove all task routes, list/show/edit/create components, navigation entries, TypeScript types, FakeRest data generators, and every reference to tasks in other components (contact aside, dashboard TasksList widget, mobile layout, settings). Remove the tasks table from the schema files.
acceptance_criteria: All files under src/components/atomic-crm/tasks/ are deleted
src/components/atomic-crm/root/CRM.tsx no longer imports or registers a 'tasks' Resource
src/components/atomic-crm/layout/ navigation components contain no task menu item
src/components/atomic-crm/dashboard/TasksList.tsx and any dashboard widget importing tasks are removed or gutted of task references
src/components/atomic-crm/contacts/ContactTasksList.tsx is deleted and its import removed from ContactAside / ContactShow
src/components/atomic-crm/providers/fakerest/dataGenerator/tasks.ts is deleted and its import removed from index.ts
supabase/schemas/01_tables.sql removes the tasks table definition
supabase/schemas/05_policies.sql removes any RLS policy referencing tasks
No TypeScript import referencing Task or tasks remains in CRM application files

non_functional_requirements.performance: No regression on contact show page render
non_functional_requirements.security: No orphan RLS policies referencing tasks table
